visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with several high-definition close-up shots of a finished plate of honey butter chicken wings. The wings are a vibrant golden-brown, glistening with a sticky glaze and speckled with golden minced garlic. They are presented on a light blue ceramic plate resting on a pink floral cloth. (2) A large glass bowl containing several raw chicken wings is shown from a top-down perspective. A person wearing transparent plastic gloves adds seasonings including black pepper, rice wine, salt, oyster sauce, sliced ginger, and chopped green onions. The hands then thoroughly mix and massage the ingredients into the meat. (3) The scene shifts to a medium shot of a male chef in a white apron standing in a brightly lit studio. He gestures with his hands while speaking directly to the camera. The background is a clean blue wall with minimalist shelf decorations. (4) Oil is drizzled into a flat frying pan with a subtle Mickey Mouse pattern. A piece of marinated chicken is shown being pressed into a bowl of white starch until fully coated. Multiple wings are then carefully placed into the hot oil in the pan. (5) Close-up of the chicken wings frying in the pan. They are flipped with chopsticks to reveal a crunchy, browned crust. Once cooked, the wings are removed and placed on a blue plate. (6) In the same pan, two blocks of butter and a portion of minced garlic are added. They melt and sizzle as they are stirred. Honey is poured in, followed by dark soy sauce. The mixture bubbles vigorously, forming a thick, aromatic glaze. (7) The crispy fried wings are placed back into the bubbling sauce or the sauce is poured over them. The final shots repeat the enticing close-ups of the finished dish, showcasing its texture and shine.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A bright, acoustic guitar-driven pop melody begins immediately at a moderate tempo. A male narrator speaks with a high-pitched, enthusiastic tone and clear articulation. He introduces the recipe with high energy, his voice projecting well over the background music which stays at a comfortable volume. (2) As the ingredients are added to the bowl, the narrator lists them one by one. The sounds of liquid being poured and the soft rustling of plastic gloves are heard. The BGM remains steady with a light drum beat supporting the acoustic guitar chords. (3) A distinct sizzling sound of hot oil occurs as the chicken is placed in the pan. This high-frequency noise is prominent but does not drown out the chef's descriptive narration. The music maintains its upbeat rhythm, syncopated with the visual cuts. (4) More intense bubbling sounds are audible as the honey and butter sauce boils. The percussive clinking of chopsticks against the metal pan and ceramic plate provides sharp transients. The narrator's tone remains friendly and instructional until the very end.
